hook: Your map of Australia shows one fence about 5,600 km long.
title: Your Map Shows a 5,600 km Dog Fence
description:
The Dingo Fence in Australia is about 5,600 km long. It was built to keep wild dogs out of the sheep country to its south. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Australia #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Fence or no fence? One word

scenes.narration: Your map of Australia shows one fence.
scenes.headline: ONE HUGE FENCE

scenes.narration: It is called the Dingo Fence.
scenes.headline: THE DINGO FENCE

scenes.narration: It was built to keep wild dogs out.
scenes.headline: KEEPING DOGS OUT

scenes.narration: Behind it lies Australia's sheep country.
scenes.headline: SHEEP COUNTRY

scenes.narration: Dingoes hunt sheep, so farmers walled them off.
scenes.headline: WALLED OFF

scenes.narration: It is among the longest structures on Earth.
scenes.headline: LONGEST ON EARTH?

scenes.narration: Your map shows one fence across a continent.
scenes.headline: A FENCE ACROSS A CONTINENT

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a moon bigger than a planet.
scenes.headline: NEXT: A GIANT MOON
